intro: Portraits first. People caught mid-turn, mid-laugh, mid-gust, plus the *cities* and *coastlines* in between.
description: Portraits, cities and landscapes by Reza M. Monadjemi (RezaMDI), a photographer based in London, Ontario.
about_text: I'm Reza M. Monadjemi, also known as RezaMDI, a photographer based in London, Ontario. Most of my work is portraits: people in natural light, on the street, in parks and by the water. Between shoots I photograph the cities and coastlines I pass through.

categories.name: People
categories.subtitle: Close up, in natural light, caught mid-moment.
